pages.title: Step by Step
pages.text: Combine several operations into one product; the reward supports a second assembly station.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Follow the installed sequence in JEI and return the intermediate item through every required step. Only the successful finished mechanism counts.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Apply small cogwheel, large cogwheel and iron-nugget deployment steps to a gold plate through five sequence loops. Complete the installed sequenced-assembly recipe, which has weighted success and salvage outputs.
